name: Cable Row
common_faults: leaning too far back and using body momentum
not fully extending at the start (losing lat stretch)

substitutions.note: bilateral free-weight; adds axial and stability demand

resistance_profile: constant cable tension through full ROM; hardest when elbows are farthest from torso

provenance.notes: Cable provides constant tension unlike barbell row. Seated position removes spinal-erector demand. Handle attachment changes grip width and muscle emphasis.
